result.reason: The clause adds a professional-and-workmanlike services warranty, a 90-day software/deliverable conformance warranty, and repair, replacement, re-performance, or refund remedies. However, it omits the required compliance-with-laws and no-malicious-code warranties and does not provide the fallback 30-day warranty period for services. The 90-day period is also tied to “delivery,” which may be unclear for a hosted Interface. The redline unnecessarily relocates existing language and refers to a Section 12 disclaimer that is not clearly identified in the text. It otherwise generally preserves unrelated commercial intent.
